_comment: Quantaureum Bridge — MAINNET configuration template (P3-5). Copy this file to configs/config.json and fill in the values. ChainID: 1668. All fields are required unless marked optional. SECURITY: Never commit filled-in configs with real private keys or governance addresses.
_usage: 1) Copy to configs/config.json. 2) Set QAU_ENABLE_BRIDGE=1 env var. 3) Fill in bridgeContractAddresses and nodeUrls. 4) Set initializerAddress to the governance multisig/contract address. 5) Set validatorPublicKeyHex and relayerPublicKeyHex from trusted sources. 6) Start the node.
_securityNotes: bootstrapMode must remain false in production (fail-closed).
initializerAddress should be a multisig or governance contract, not an EOA.
validatorPublicKeyHex and relayerPublicKeyHex must come from trusted QPOS validator set or governance.
nodeUrls for external chains should use HTTPS endpoints with API keys.
